name: Utashinai (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Utashinai city emblem in black: an outlined hexagon enclosing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Utashinai, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 October 1942.

features.role: Utashinai city emblem — an outlined hexagon enclosing a ring with a stylised character
